s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish-brown skin lesion with peripheral ecchymosis
salient_findings: Reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
Poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation
key_facts: Previous treatment with topical antifungal cream showed no improvement
Vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40
Negative for human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) and Wilms tumor 1 (WT1)
Ki-67 index showed low proliferation in endothelial cells
HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C serologic tests were negative

shortlist.label: Targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish-brown skin lesion with peripheral ecchymosis and histologic findings of vascular proliferation and hemosiderin deposits

shortlist.label: Hobnail hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Shares similar histologic features, including vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40, and presence of hemosiderin deposits

shortlist.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by similar vascular proliferation and presence of hemosiderin deposits, consistent with the patient's clinical and histologic findings

shortlist.label: Spindle cell hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with similar clinical and histologic features, including a gradually enlarging, reddish-brown lesion and vascular proliferation with hemosiderin deposits

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation and histologic findings, including vascular proliferation and presence of hemosiderin deposits, although less common than other options

raw.rationale: The clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish hematomalike plaque with a brownish peripheral border, combined with the histologic findings of poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation and the presence of hemosiderin deposits, is consistent with targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma. The immunohistochemical profile, including positivity for CD31, CD34, and D2-40, and negativity for HHV-8 and WT1, also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hobnail hemangioma
rejected.why: Hobnail hemangioma typically presents with a more distinctive 'hobnail' appearance of the endothelial cells, which is not mentioned in the histologic findings.

rejected.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
rejected.why: Glomeruloid hemangioma is often associated with POEMS syndrome and typically has a more complex vascular architecture, which is not described in the case.

rejected.label: Spindle cell hemangioma
rejected.why: Spindle cell hemangioma typically has a more prominent spindle cell component and often presents with a more nodular or multinodular appearance, which is not consistent with the clinical description.

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
rejected.why: Epithelioid hemangioma typically has a more prominent epithelioid endothelial cell component and often presents with a more inflammatory or angiomatous appearance, which is not described in the case.
